# RFC 9180 (HPKE) test vectors for the two DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) suites.
#
# Source: the RFC's own Appendix A, retrieved from
#   https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9180.txt
# Appendix A.1 is HKDF-SHA256 with AES-128-GCM, A.2 the same KEM and KDF with
# ChaCha20Poly1305; each has the four modes A.x.1 base, A.x.2 PSK, A.x.3 auth
# and A.x.4 auth-PSK. Every value is copied verbatim, with the RFC's line
# wrapping undone; nothing else was edited.
#
# Names read <AEAD>_<MODE>_<FIELD>. SEQ0 and SEQ1 are the first two records of
# the suite's "Encryptions" subsection and EXPORT0..2 the three of its
# "Exported Values" subsection.
